title: Deliver generic Hosaka web gateway, portable CLI installers, and single .db consolidation
acceptance: hosaka-gateway serves approved web extensions at /{extension_id}/, installs portable CLI wrappers, initializes citations.db and virgo-zone.db without duplicates, and passes all gateway/installer tests.
evidence: 11 gateway and installer tests pass; live browser verification passed on http://127.0.0.1:8086/ for /citations/ and /virgo-zone/.

title: Verify hosaka update carries hosaka-gateway and extensions onto Raspberry Pi
acceptance: Running hosaka update on a Raspberry Pi pulls/syncs hosaka-gateway and extensions, initializes .db files, and serves apps cleanly.
